001package org.clafer.ast.compiler;
002
003import java.util.Collections;
004import java.util.Map;
005import org.clafer.assertion.Assertion;
006import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
007import org.clafer.ast.AstConstraint;
008import org.clafer.ast.AstException;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstModel;
010import org.clafer.ast.analysis.Analysis;
011import org.clafer.common.Check;
012import org.clafer.ir.IrBoolVar;
013import org.clafer.ir.IrIntVar;
014import org.clafer.ir.IrSetVar;
015import org.clafer.ir.IrStringVar;
016import org.clafer.objective.Objective;
017
018/**
019 *
020 * @author jimmy
021 */
022public class AstSolutionMap {
023
024    private final AstModel model;
025    private final Map<AstClafer, IrBoolVar[]> memberVars;
026    private final Map<AstClafer, IrSetVar[]> siblingVars;
027    private final Map<AstClafer, IrIntVar[]> siblingBounds;
028    private final Map<AstClafer, IrIntVar[]> refVars;
029    private final Map<AstClafer, IrStringVar[]> refStrings;
030    private final Map<AstConstraint, IrBoolVar> softVars;
031    private final IrIntVar sumSoftVar;
032    private final Map<Objective, IrIntVar> objectiveVars;
033    private final Map<Assertion, IrBoolVar> assertionVars;
034    private final Analysis analysis;
035
036    AstSolutionMap(AstModel model,
037            Map<AstClafer, IrBoolVar[]> memberVars,
038            Map<AstClafer, IrSetVar[]> siblingVars,
039            Map<AstClafer, IrIntVar[]> siblingBounds,
040            Map<AstClafer, IrIntVar[]> refVars,
041            Map<AstClafer, IrStringVar[]> refStrings,
042            Map<AstConstraint, IrBoolVar> softVars,
043            IrIntVar sumSoftVar,
044            Map<Objective, IrIntVar> objectiveVars,
045            Map<Assertion, IrBoolVar> assertionVars,
046            Analysis analysis) {
047        this.model = Check.notNull(model);
048        this.memberVars = memberVars;
049        this.siblingVars = Check.notNull(siblingVars);
050        this.siblingBounds = Check.notNull(siblingBounds);
051        this.refVars = Check.notNull(refVars);
052        this.refStrings = Check.notNull(refStrings);
053        this.softVars = Check.notNull(softVars);
054        this.sumSoftVar = Check.notNull(sumSoftVar);
055        this.objectiveVars = Check.notNull(objectiveVars);
056        this.assertionVars = Check.notNull(assertionVars);
057        this.analysis = Check.notNull(analysis);
058    }
059
060    public AstModel getModel() {
061        return model;
062    }
063
064    public Analysis getAnalysis() {
065        return analysis;
066    }
067
068    public IrBoolVar[] getMemberVars(AstClafer clafer) {
069        return notNull(clafer + " not part of the AST solution", memberVars.get(clafer));
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * Returns the sibling variables associated with the Clafer.
074     *
075     * @param clafer the Clafer
076     * @return the sibling variables associated with the Clafer
077     */
078    public IrSetVar[] getSiblingVars(AstClafer clafer) {
079        return notNull(clafer + " not part of the AST solution", siblingVars.get(clafer));
080    }
081
082    public IrIntVar[] getSiblingBounds(AstClafer clafer) {
083        return siblingBounds.get(clafer);
084    }
085
086    /**
087     * Returns the reference variables associated to the reference.
088     *
089     * @param clafer the Clafer
090     * @return the reference variables associated to the reference
091     */
092    public IrIntVar[] getRefVars(AstClafer clafer) {
093        return notNull(clafer + "'s reference not part of the AST solution", refVars.get(clafer));
094    }
095
096    public IrStringVar[] getRefStrings(AstClafer clafer) {
097        return notNull(clafer + "'s reference not part of the AST solution", refStrings.get(clafer));
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Returns the soft variable associated to the constraint.
102     *
103     * @param constraint the constraint
104     * @return the soft variable associated to the constraint
105     */
106    public IrBoolVar getSoftVar(AstConstraint constraint) {
107        return notNull(constraint + " not a compiled soft constraint", softVars.get(constraint));
108    }
109
110    public IrBoolVar[] getSoftVars() {
111        return softVars.values().toArray(new IrBoolVar[softVars.size()]);
112    }
113
114    public Map<AstConstraint, IrBoolVar> getSoftVarsMap() {
115        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(softVars);
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * Returns the variable equal to the sum of the soft variables.
120     *
121     * @return the variable equal to the sum of the soft variables
122     */
123    public IrIntVar getSumSoftVar() {
124        return sumSoftVar;
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * Returns the variable associated to the objective.
129     *
130     * @param objective the objective
131     * @return the variable associated to the objective
132     */
133    public IrIntVar getObjectiveVar(Objective objective) {
134        return notNull(objective + " not a compiled objective", objectiveVars.get(objective));
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * Returns the variable associated to the assertion.
139     *
140     * @param assertion the assertion
141     * @return the variable associated to the assertion
142     */
143    public IrBoolVar getAssertionVar(Assertion assertion) {
144        return notNull(assertion + " not a compiled assertion", assertionVars.get(assertion));
145    }
146
147    private static <T> T notNull(String message, T t) {
148        if (t == null) {
149            throw new AstException(message);
150        }
151        return t;
152    }
153}
